steps.title: From sign-up to civic action inside 3 minutes

join.title: Create your verified account
join.body: Sign up with your name and basic details. Verification na wetin make sure say every signature and report come from real resident.

pick.title: Select your ward and LGA
pick.body: Pick your state, your LGA, and your ward so your feed go bring the streetlight, road, and issue wey dey right outside your door.

act.title: Log issue or back petition
act.body: Snap picture of community issue or sign resident petition. We go timestamp wetin you submit and log am on the public record.

follow.title: Follow the response in real time
follow.body: We go notify you the moment rep respond, petition hit im milestone, or issue wey you log change status to resolved.

faq.title: Clear answer for citizens and public officials

cost.a: Yes, always. Reporting issue, signing local petition, following reps, and receiving live status alert no go cost residents anything. Public institutions and NGOs fit pay for advanced tools, but the citizen experience dey free.

privacy.q: How CivicOS dey protect my private personal information?
privacy.a: Your email, phone number, and house address dey private and we no dey share dem publicly. Na only your display name and the public action wey you take — issue you log, petition you sign, comment you drop — dey show for the platform.

coverage.q: Wetin happen if my LGA chairman or ward rep no dey CivicOS yet?
coverage.a: You fit still log issue and start petition. When official for your constituency join, the report wey already dey for their ward go show for their dashboard automatically — nothing wey you file go lost.

reps.q: Reps and council officials dey really respond?
reps.a: We dey onboard officials ward by ward, and their response rate dey for their public profile. E cut both ways: when office answer, residents go see am, and when e keep quiet, that one dey on record too.

abuse.q: How una dey stop fake account, spam, and bot signature?
abuse.a: Every account dey pass identity verification. Petition dey enforce strict one citizen, one signature rule, and report wey enter get rate limit and we dey moderate dem against community standards.

ownership.q: Who dey run CivicOS, and e get any political party behind am?
ownership.a: CivicOS na independent, non-partisan civic technology wey we build on open-source code. No political party or business interest own am, fund am, or control am, and the codebase dey public for anybody to audit.

stories.title: Three things wey change when the record na public

issues.title: Streetlight wey spoil dey get owner
issues.body: Resident for Dankande Street file am once, with picture and location. Neighbours fit see am, LGA office fit see am, and so any person wey dey ask why e take three weeks.

consultations.title: Consultation wey publish outcome
consultations.body: Council open window on market relocation, collect structured input from traders and residents, then post the decision and the reason back for the same thread.

reps.title: Councilor answer stop to be hearsay
reps.body: When rep promise repair date, we write am down with timestamp for their profile — so the follow-up question go get something to point at.

stewardship.title: Independent, non-partisan, and built for the open
stewardship.body: Small independent team dey steward CivicOS, no be party and no be contractor. The full codebase, database schema, and API dey public — anybody fit read how we store report, who fit see am, and wetin happen after you file am.

openSource.title: Anybody fit audit am
openSource.body: Every service, migration, and API route dey inside public repository under open licence. If you wan check how we handle your data, read the source.

invite.title: We dey open ward by ward
invite.body: CivicOS dey roll out community by community instead of claiming national coverage wey e no get. If you lead community association or you work for LGA office, you fit bring your ward on early.

contribute.title: Contributions welcome
contribute.body: Developers, translators, and civic researchers fit open issue or pull request. The docs cover the architecture, local setup, and how to contribute.

newsletter.title: Stay updated on CivicOS for your state
newsletter.sub: One email every month about new LGA rollout, big community win, and platform update. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.
